rows.details: Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company Limited (MAHATRANSCO)

content_sections.heading: MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete the establishment registration process and submit their online application within the specified period. Applications submitted after the deadline will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification mentions Apprentice training opportunities under Maharashtra State Electricity Transmission Company Limited, Kalwa. The establishment registration number provided in the notification is E10162701237.

content_sections.heading: MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Apprentice posts must fulfil the educational qualification and age requirements mentioned in the official notification. Passed Maharashtra State Secondary School Certificate Examination. Passed Electrician trade examination from an Industrial Training Institute recognised by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT), New Delhi. The required qualification details are mentioned in the notification. The age limit for MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 38 years. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for reserved category candidates as per rules.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Application 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates need to upload scanned copies of required original documents while applying online. The notification mentions the following documents: SSC and ITI Electrician semester mark sheets Aadhaar Card Caste Certificate (for reserved category candidates) Maharashtra State Domicile Certificate Non-Creamy Layer Certificate wherever applicable Other required supporting documents Candidates must scan and upload the required documents properly on their profile while submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection of Apprentice candidates will be made based on SSC and ITI Electrician marks percentage, subject to eligibility conditions and reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the Apprenticeship India portal. Complete the establishment registration/application process. Fill in the required personal and educational details. Upload scanned copies of required documents. Submit the online application before the last date. Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference. The online application window is available from 24 August 2026 to 07 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Candidates
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications or applications with incorrect documents will not be considered. The name on SSC and ITI Electrician certificates should match the Aadhaar card details. Candidates must provide an active email ID and mobile number during application. False information provided in the application may lead to disqualification. These instructions are mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 07 September 2026 up to 24:00 hours.

faq.question: Q2. How many Apprentice vacancies are available in MAHATRANSCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 68 Apprentice vacancies are mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for MAHATRANSCO Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC and NCVT recognised ITI Electrician trade examination.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 38 years. Reserved category candidates receive 5 years age relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for MAHATRANSCO Apprentice Recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on SSC and ITI Electrician marks percentage along with applicable reservation rules.
